identity.notes: Read-only endpoint set; requires at least directory read permissions in app registration. AuditLog.Read.All plus Microsoft Entra ID P1/P2 adds user signInActivity for stale-account findings; without it identity still runs and records a coverage gap.

security.notes: Sign-in and directory audit data is typically available for read-only security roles with audit permissions.

conditional_access.notes: Conditional Access policy graph endpoints are policy-scoped and may require policy admin or equivalent directory read roles.

defender.notes: Defender alerts (alerts_v2), incidents and secure score APIs are covered by Security Reader in most environments. The legacy /security/alerts API retires on 2026-10-15.

service_health.notes: Service health and message center data is available in read-only audit scenarios when reporting permissions are granted.

purview.notes: Most collector commands are CLI-driven and require authenticated M365 CLI session plus app-level Purview/eDiscovery permissions.
optional_commands: m365 purview dlp policy list --output json
m365 purview auditlog export create --output json --help

ediscovery.notes: Export and hold operations may be CLI-driven and require additional compliance/eDiscovery tenant permissions.
optional_commands: m365 purview ediscovery case list --output json
m365 purview ediscovery search list --output json
m365 purview ediscovery reviewset list --output json

auth_methods.notes: Authentication method policy and registration reports can require report-reading access.

reports_usage.notes: Global Reader can access tenant-level usage reporting, while detailed report visibility often requires Reports Reader or a workload-specific reader role. ReportSettings.Read.All reads /admin/reportSettings first; when displayConcealedNames is true, per-user report rows are hashed and Auditex records reports_usage.concealed_names.

external_identity.notes: External identity policy inventory covers cross-tenant access, invitation policy, and authentication flow posture.

consent_policy.notes: Consent policy inventory covers admin consent workflow and permission grant policies.

cross_tenant_access.notes: Cross-tenant access settings are read via /policies/crossTenantAccessPolicy and surface default and partner-scoped trust posture.

domains_hybrid.notes: Hybrid posture is inferred from domains and sampled on-premises sync markers on users.

dns_posture.notes: Resolves email-auth DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI) over DoH for verified tenant domains. Live runs also make unauthenticated, read-only HTTPS GETs for those verified domains only: the MTA-STS policy file (https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt, only when the _mta-sts TXT record exists, no redirects) and the public Entra OpenID discovery document (https://login.microsoftonline.com/<domain>/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration). No usernames are probed. Offline runs make no lookups.

intune.notes: Will return empty/unavailable datasets if tenant lacks Intune licensing.

sharepoint.notes: SharePoint tenant settings and site inventory can vary by role and service readiness.

sharepoint_access.notes: Sampled site permissions are attempted in a reader-first mode, but Graph site permission depth can require stronger SharePoint privileges or app-only escalation.

onedrive_posture.notes: OneDrive posture uses SharePoint read APIs and site URL heuristics; admin-center-only OneDrive details may still be unavailable to Global Reader.

power_platform.notes: Power Platform admin posture relies on the Business App Platform (BAP) admin API. The collector is capability-gated: pass a Power Platform admin bearer token via context to enable live collection, otherwise the collector emits a structured 'service_not_available' diagnostic.

sentinel_xdr.notes: Capability-gated. Reads /security/incidents and /security/alerts_v2 from Microsoft Graph; tenants without unified XDR / Sentinel ingestion will yield empty results, surfaced as 'service_not_available' diagnostics.

identity_protection.notes: Capability-gated. Reads one page of GET /identityProtection/riskyUsers (Graph v1.0, read-only) and keeps aggregate counts only; no user names or UPNs are stored. Requires Microsoft Entra ID P2; a licensing error is reported as risk detection 'off', permission errors as 'unknown'.

defender_cloud_apps.notes: Capability-gated. Reads pending app consent requests only. Microsoft Graph has no documented REST endpoint for Defender for Cloud Apps app risk profiles, so those are not collected; review them in the Defender portal.

copilot_governance.notes: Capability-gated. Reads /copilot/admin/settings/limitedMode (delegated only; app-only runs record a coverage gap) and the aggregate /copilot/reports/getMicrosoft365CopilotUserCountSummary CSV. No per-user Copilot activity or interaction content is read. Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing; failure modes map to 'service_not_available'.

teams.notes: Teams endpoints are still readable in many read-only role patterns.

teams_policy.notes: Teams policy depth uses PowerShell-backed cmdlets and usually needs Teams PowerShell tooling and tenant admin connectivity.

app_consent.notes: Enterprise application consent depth depends on delegated grant and app role assignment visibility.

app_credentials.notes: Application credential hygiene reads passwordCredentials, keyCredentials, redirect URIs, federatedIdentityCredentials, and owner counts via Microsoft Graph. AuditLog.Read.All enables the Graph beta servicePrincipalSignInActivities report used for dormant-application findings; when unavailable the collector records a coverage gap and the dormant rule stays inert.

licensing.notes: License assignment details are sampled and can be cross-correlated with SKU inventory.

identity_governance.notes: Governance and PIM schedule visibility depends on Entra ID Governance licensing and role-scoped APIs.

intune_depth.notes: Deeper Intune policy and assignment surfaces can still return empty or partial results when Intune is not licensed or the tenant does not use those workloads. groupPolicyConfigurations and deviceManagementScripts are Graph beta endpoints; script metadata is read with a fixed $select that excludes scriptContent.

exchange.notes: Command-based Exchange posture relies on Microsoft 365 CLI tenant and report commands; mailbox presence falls back to Graph only when CLI reporting is unavailable.
optional_commands: m365 outlook report mailboxusagemailboxcount --period D30 --output json
m365 outlook report mailboxusagedetail --period D30 --output json
m365 outlook report mailboxusagequotastatusmailboxcounts --period D30 --output json
m365 outlook report mailboxusagestorage --period D30 --output json
m365 outlook report mailactivitycounts --period D30 --output json

mailbox_forwarding.notes: Inbox rules (messageRules) and mailbox settings are read with the MailboxSettings.Read permission (application or delegated). Mail.Read is never requested: the audit does not read message content.

exchange_policy.notes: Exchange policy depth uses read-only Exchange PowerShell Get-* cmdlets and requires PowerShell plus Exchange connectivity. Detection-coverage cmdlets (Get-AdminAuditLogConfig, Get-OrganizationConfig, Get-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation counted only) need an Exchange Online PowerShell session; Get-ProtectionAlert is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell (Connect-IPPSSession). None of these cmdlets change tenant state; a missing session is reported as an 'unknown' detection signal, never 'off'.
